text: The Horde Expedition oversees all the forces of the Horde in Northrend including: * The Hand of Vengeance (Forsaken) * The Taunka (Taunka) * The Warsong Offensive (Primarily Orcs, Tauren, Mag'har and Trolls) * The Sunreavers (Blood Elves) Their Alliance counterpart is the Alliance Vanguard. If no other Championing tabard is worn in Championing dungeons, Horde Players will gain reputation with this faction instead.
Horizon Scout Engineers are humans supposedly trapped within the captain's quarters of the Horizon Scout off the shores of Azshara.
Horizon Scout Crewman were humans found in the Ruined Reaches of Azshara. They are the crew of the Horizon Scout.
Horgoru the Collector is a Stone giant general goods vendor at Bouldercrag's Refuge in the Storm Peaks.
Horde Silithyst Sentinels are Forsaken found at the Hive'Regal Horde camp in Silithus.
The Horned Helm of Varos drops from Varos Cloudstrider in the Oculus on normal mode.

Horde Halaani Guards are the guards that come to protect the town of Halaa when it is under control of the Horde. There are 15 of them, men and women, stationed throughout the town at various buildings, on patrols and keeping watch at the bridges which are the entrance/exits. They are very strong and are very hard to defeat in hand to hand combat and are usually brought down by the fire bombs that the Alliance launch at them from above.
__NOTOC__ Horned Cobalt Helm is created with Blacksmithing (400); taught by trainers.

The Horn of the Peaks is provided as an objective by Thorim for The Earthen Oath and Loken's Lackeys at the Terrace of the Makers. The character summons several Oathbound Warders with the horn. These warders act in the fashion of controllable pets. For more details, see The Earthen Oath.
Horde Herb Pouches drop from Living Lashers and Horde players at the Steppe of Life in Wintergrasp. Each member of a party or raid group can loot this item from a body if they have the quest.

These Horn Fragments are the collected pieces of Hodir's Horn, which the player had collected previously during the quest In Memoriam (quest). During the quest A Monument to the Fallen, the player takes them to Njormeld, to be forged into monument in honor of those who perished in the Thunderfall, and in remembrance of the glory of battle at Thorim's side.

A Horde territory is any area in which Alliance players will find their PvP flags automatically turned on. Any Alliance player can be attacked by a player of the Horde while in these zones. Unlike contested territories, it does not matter whether you have war mode on or not. All Horde capital cities are considered Horde territory to Alliance players, regardless of the player's current war mode status. With the war mode on, the Horde territory is extended to encompass all Horde starting areas, as well as Northern Barrens, Azshara, Ghostlands (except for the sub-zone Hatchet Hills, which is contested) and Silverpine Forest. Horde Axe Thrower is a jungle troll axe thrower located on the road in the west of Northern Barrens.

Horns of the Spurned Val'kyr drops form Scourgelord Tyrannus in Pit of Saron.
Horde Gunship Cannons are cannons located aboard Orgrim's Hammer in Icecrown Citadel
Horde Peons are peons who appear at the Battle for Mount Hyjal in the Caverns of Time.
Horde Grunts are orc grunts who appear at the Battle for Mount Hyjal in the Caverns of Time.
Horde Shaman are shaman who appear at the Battle for Mount Hyjal in the Caverns of Time.
Horde Headhunters are headhunters who appear at the Battle for Mount Hyjal in the Caverns of Time.
Horde Witch Doctors are witch doctors who appear at the Battle for Mount Hyjal in the Caverns of Time.
Horde Siege Tanks are demolisher-like siege engines, parked on the coast west of Warsong Hold. They are used for the quest The Plains of Nasam.
Horn of Tal'doren is a quest item provided for Take Back What's Ours.
Horde Chest Key is found in the body of the huge sea snake Akasha, which swims in a sea snake swarm above a Gorrok's Lament in Kelp'thar Forest. It is used to open the Sunken Horde Chest.

The Horde Coffin Hauler serves as a means of transportation for lower-level characters within Silverpine Forest. The wagon is pulled by a Subdued Forest Ettin, and is driven by a Horde Engineer. It is full of coffins. It runs from the Forsaken Front to the very northern edge of the zone. It does not stop. It only runs south-to-north, and despawns at the end of its course, ejecting players.
The Horn of Challenge is provided as an objective for the following quests: *Diplomacy By Another Means *Speaking Their Language
Horn of Ramkahen is provided by High Commander Kamses for Ancient Weapons. Using it summons Ramkahen Laborers.
The Horde's Proposal is obtained from Trackmaster Zherin at the Splithoof Heights in the Thousand Needles.
The Horde Standard is provided for A Standard Day for Azrajar (Horde).
Horde Slayer is a PvP guild achievement which requires the guild to complete each of the Slayer achievements listed.

Horde Base Camp is a small camp setup by the Orc Survivors led by Aggra on the Lost Isles. It overlooks the wreckage of the Draka's Fury and ancient night elf ruins. Chawg, a vendor, can also be found here. Occasionally SI:7 Infiltrators attack the camp.
The Horde Infantry Rations is an objective of daily cooking quest Even Thieves Get Hungry.
__NOTOC__ Horde Portal-Sentries are Horde guards found near the Dark Portal in the Blasted Lands.

The Horde Hauler serves as a means of transportation for lower level characters within Silverpine Forest. The wagon is pulled by a Subdued Forest Ettin, and is driven by a Horde Engineer. Forsaken Troopers ride in it. It makes periodic stops along the main road at Forsaken High Command, the crossroads in front of The Sepulcher, and in The Forsaken Front. It only runs north-to-south, ejecting players at The Forsaken Front, and despawning shortly down the road.
__NOTOC__ Horde Balloon is a quest reward from Blown Away (Horde).
__NOTOC__ Horrid Abominations are elite abominations attacking the town of Duskhaven in Gilneas.

The Horde Landing is the starting point for Horde players in the Battle for Gilneas battleground, and their headquarters on the Gilnean Coast. It possesses a graveyard that will always remain in Horde possession throughout the game. Having docked on an abandoned Gilnean pier, the Horde Landing is a Forsaken battleship that delivers the players every game. The Landing is closest to the Mines base, which is often the first to be captured by the Horde.

__NOTOC__ Horghast Flarecrazed is Dark Iron dwarf and leader of the invasion force that seized control over Menethil Keep. Captain Stoutfist wants him dead. After some time, Horghast Flarecrazed returns from the dead and makes an appearance in The Battle of Thandol Span. Not wanting to be ruled under Moira, he swore loyalty to the Twilight's Hammer. After Calamoth Ashbeard is killed, Horghast and the others turn into purple-blueish smoke. Whether it means that they could only stay alive because of Calamoth Ashbeard or they retreated remains unclear.
Horde Druids can be found at Forlorn Hut on the Wandering Isle, tending to Injured Horde Crewmen. They are later at the Wreck of the Skyseeker to help heal Shen-zin Su's wound.
Hornbill Strider only spawns when looting the Hornbill Strider Egg inside the cave at the Singing Marshes in the Valley of the Four Winds during A Taste For Eggs.
Hopeless Monks are pandaren found at the Temple of the Red Crane in Krasarang Wilds.
Hopeless Acolytes are pandaren found at the Temple of the Red Crane in Krasarang Wilds.
The Horde Seadog is a deceased orc located on the Wreck of the Vanguard in the Jade Forest.
Horoo the Flamekeeper is a wildkin ghost found in Darkshore. For some reason he's classified as humanoid instead of undead.

The Horrid March is a sha-tainted path stretching from the Heart of Fear and the Clutches of Shek'zeer on the west side of Dread Wastes to the Gate of the Setting Sun on the Serpent's Spine in Vale of Eternal Blossoms and to Stoneplow in the Valley of the Four Winds.
Horde Invaders are members of the Horde attacking Maestra's Post in Ashenvale.
The Horns of the Left Hand Path item is a quest reward from Stones of Binding (Blackrock Depths) (Horde). This is the same model as the Felheart Raiment.
The Horde Negotiator is a companion who appears during the Twilight Highlands quest Madness (quest). The player is asked to escort the Negotiator to Warchief Mor'ghor at Dragonmaw Port.
The Horde Communication Panel is a device in which Admiral Hatchet communicates with the adventurer.
Hopling is a reward for completing the Dungeons & Raids achievement Ling-Ting's Herbal Journey.
__NOTOC__ Horned Lizards are lizards found in Uldum and Vol'dun.
__NOTOC__ Horny Toads are lizards located in Desolace and Tanaan Jungle.

The Horde Fireworks were contained within the Spoils of Theramore loot bag which was acquired upon completing the level-85 version of Theramore's Fall scenario before the release of Mists of Pandaria.
Horde Raiders are orcs located in Krasarang Cove in Krasarang Wilds.
__NOTOC__ Horde Hunters are tauren located in Krasarang Cove in the Krasarang Wilds.

__NOTOC__ Horde Priests are shadow priests fighting against the Alliance in Krasarang Cove and Horde Landing Site in the Krasarang Wilds. They can be found both attacking Lion's Landing and defending Domination Point.
Horned Battlebeasts are direhorns located in the Beast Pens on the Isle of Thunder. They are ridden by a Disciple of Jalak.
Horgak the Enslaver is a mogu leader found in the central tower in the Diremoor on the Isle of Thunder that plans to mount attacks against the Kirin Tor Offensive and the Sunreaver Onslaught.
Hopsmaster Chang is a pandaren found on the outskirts of Halfhill in the Valley of the Four Winds.
Hordebreaker is an Alliance-only Legacy achievement awarded during Patch 5.3 for participation in the Battlefield: Barrens world event.
The Horde Cage Key can be looted from Krom'gar Infantry during Free Our Sisters. The keys unlock the cages holding Captured Huntresses, who must be freed for the quest.
Hopswift is a grummle located at the Celestial Court on the Timeless Isle.
__NOTOC__ The Horned Mace of the Old Ones drops from Garrosh Hellscream in the Siege of Orgrimmar.
__NOTOC__ Hopeglow Spaulders drop from Garrosh Hellscream in the Siege of Orgrimmar.
Hopocalypse Now! is an achievement earned for smashing 100 Virmen with a single hammer swing in Stormstout Brewery on heroic difficulty.
Horde Deckhands are level 90 Forsaken aboard the ships during the Battle on the High Seas scenario.
Horde Swashbucklers are Forsaken aboard the ships during the Battle on the High Seas scenario.
Horde Cannoneers are level 90 goblins aboard the ships during the Battle on the High Seas scenario.

Horde Captains are level 90 orc captains of the Horde, commanding the Horde battleships during the Battle on the High Seas scenario. Admiral Hagman oversees the fleet, and his orders are executed through a bunch of lieutenants who oversee the Horde Captains. Each of the Horde Captains are in charge of a ship crew consisting of cannoneers, deckhands, officers, squallshapers and swashbucklers.
Horde Officers are level 90 jungle trolls aboard the ships during the Battle on the High Seas scenario.
Horde Squallshapers are level 90 orcs aboard the ships during the Battle on the High Seas scenario.
Horned Skull is found at / in the center room of the lower level of the Fissure of Fury in Gorgrond. It can be looted for 25 Garrison Resources.
Horde Supply Chest Key can be used to unlock Horde Supply Chests, objects sometimes found at Horde-occupied bases in Ashran.
Horde Supply Chest are objects found in Ashran. Occasionally found at Horde-controlled bases within the zone, they can be unlock using Horde Supply Chest Key.

The Horde Encampment is located in the Hyjal Summit area during the Battle for Mount Hyjal. It is traveled to after the Alliance Base falls. Here, Kaz'rogal and Azgalor are fought with the help of Thrall. The base is made up of buildings and units inspired by how they were in Warcraft III. Its wooden palisade leads into an entrance protected by watch towers and a burrow. There are also a stronghold, barracks, a kennel, several jungle troll huts and tauren tents probably intended to respectively represent a voodoo lounge and a spirit lodge, as well as several tauren totems. Several other orcish buildings are also scattered in the encampment. The base is populated with grunts, headhunters, tau
Horgg is a gronnling located at The Pit in Gorgrond. It is ridden by an Iron Artilleryman.

Horde Sailors are orcs, goblins and Forsaken located on the ships in the Frostwall Shipyard. One orc sailor with Fleet Command Table is present in Frostwall's Town Hall upon reaching Tier 3 Frostwall Shipyard.
Horde Strongbox is mailed to the first Horde character an account logs into during the Warcraft film promotion, from May 25 to August 1, 2016.

Horde Recruits are Horde soldiers located at the Dranosh'ar Blockade prior to the Battle for the Broken Shore. They can be seen engaging in a variety of things, like discussing, training or enjoying a last meal before the assault on the Broken Shore. Curiously, they can't be seen during the battle itself.
__NOTOC__ Horde Supplies can be found around the ruined Alliance tower just southwest of Tarren Mill during Legion Invasion.
Horde Engineers are goblin engineers located on the Tempest's Roar prior to the battle for the Broken Shore.
Horde Wind Riders are wyvern riders escorting the Tempest's Roar prior to the battle for the Broken Shore.
Horn of the Nightmare Lord is a quest item for The Emerald Nightmare: In Nightmares.
The Horadric Satchel was obtained from Treasure Goblins during the Diablo's 20th Anniversary event.
Horkin' Stuff-Lobbers drop from Opera Hall: Wikket in the Return to Karazhan.
Horde Qiraji Commendation once earned will automatically add it to the server-wide credit as shown near the top center of the screen during the Call of the Scarab event.

The Horde Runners are a group of three elite Horde NPCs that roam the eastern side of the Loch in Loch Modan. They have a tendency to gank unsuspecting Alliance players, and these victims usually return to gank them at a higher level in return.
__NOTOC__ Horde Soldiers are orc, jungle troll, tauren, and blood elf soldiers located at the Stair of Destiny in Hellfire Peninsula. They appear during the Children's Week.
Alliance Siege Cannon is a cannon located at Andorhal in The Deaths of Chromie scenario.
Horde Demolishers were demolishers that first appeared in Razor Hill and in Orgrimmar. They were maintained by Goblin Engineers.
Horde Poachers are orcs located in Feralas. They appear during Forces of Nature: Hippogryphs.

The Horizon's Edge was the ship of Dread Admiral Eliza. The leader of the Uncrowned and the The Crimson Veil crew under Fleet Admiral Tethys command boarded it in order to get the Dreadblades. Afterwards, the Bloodsail Buccaneers took the ship.

Horrible Haunter was an ogre ghost located in Haunted Precipice in Talador. He was taken out by the followers sent from the Frostwall and Lunarfall garrisons.

Horde Slaves are elites who have been captured by the Scourge and forced to work inside the Pit of Saron. Horde adventurers need to free fifteen slaves and kill Scourgelord Tyrannus to complete the progression quest The Path to the Citadel (Horde) to gain access to the Halls of Reflection.
__NOTOC__ Horde Vanguards are Horde soldiers located at the Horde embassy in Dazar'alor. Some of them are spectating at the Mugambala.
Horde Mage Infantries are jungle trolls located in Tol Barad.
While the Horde Toy Cape itself is unobtainable, its appearance is equipped through the use of Toy Armor Set#Horde.
__NOTOC__ Horde Warriors are located in Wor'var and Lok-rath in . They also participated in the attack on Grommashar.
Hops, Line, & Sinker Brewing is located right next to Ravens Flock Tavern in northern Boralus. The establishment has both brewery, bars and a food court. Jay the Tavern Bard plays here.
The Horde Brew Master was a pandaren located in the cut Defense of the Alehouse battleground.
Horde Healing Wards are healing wards located in Hyjal Summit.
Horde Orphans are orc and goblin children located in Orgrimmar.

Horde Wyvern was a wyvern located in the Wound in Silithus transporting Horde adventurers from the Horde base at Southwind Village into the Horde gunship near the Sword of Sargeras and it could take them out of the gunship back to the base but that was not required.

Horde Banners were needed to be placed in the Blackwood Den in Darkshore during the War of the Thorns.
Horde Combatants were orcs located in the Ruins of Mathystra in Darkshore during the War of the Thorns.
Horde Ambassadors are jungle trolls, goblins, and tauren located in the Great Seal.
Horde Infra-green Engineer is a goblin located at Aldur'thar: The Desolation Gate in Icecrown.

The Horde War Campaign is a questline involving a Horde campaign against the Alliance during the Fourth War. The progression of the war storyline is tracked in the achievements Ready for War (Horde), Tides of Vengeance (achievement) (Horde), and The Fourth War (Horde). <!-- ==Story==
Horrific Amalgam's Hood drops from Fetid Devourer in Uldir.
Horde Bounties are sacks that drop from Horde players who have a bounty on their head.
The Horde Merchant was a Goblin Merchant in the area of Tidefury Cove.
__NOTOC__ Horrific Apparitions are voidwalkers located in Ar'gorok and Stromgarde Keep in the Arathi Highlands.
Hopeless Reflections are voidwalker located in Tomb of Sargeras.

The Horde navy, formerly known as the Orcish Armada, is the collective maritime military force of the various members of the Horde. As the naval wing of the Horde military, these combined navies protect the Horde's interests throughout Azeroth and beyond, and have seen particularly frequent service against the Alliance and its navy.

Horde's Might Firework is available from the Blizzard Shop or the In-Game Store for $10 or €10. It was released on March 19, 2019, along with Lion's Pride Firework. It is no longer available since 17 April 2023 but may return in the future as part of the Trading Post and/or future WoW deals.
Horde War Wolf is a wolf located in Defiler's Den in Arathi Basin in a pen with Forsaken Warhorse.
The Horn of Helheim is a quest reward from Stormheim's Salvation.

The Horde Water Barrel can be found on the western shore of Ethereal Lake in the Jade Forest, very close to where is standing. Players fill the barrel with water to eventually put out the fires at the nearby Wreck of the Sky Shark, snuffing any flames that might attract unwanted attention.
Hornriged Crusher drops from Grong, the Jungle Lord for the Horde and Grong, the Revenant for the Alliance in the Battle of Dazar'alor.
The Horde War Standard is a toy summoning a Horde banner carried in the players' hands which also works when mounted, but the effect is lost when entering combat.
The Horde War Banner is a toy summoning a Horde banner carried in the players' hands which also works when mounted, but the effect is lost when entering combat.
Horde Skirmishers are soldiers located in Nazjatar during The Tide Turns.
Horde Bombardiers are zeppelins located in Anglepoint Wharf in Tiragarde Sound during the Alliance War Campaign.
Horde Rowboats are rowboat carrying Invading Horde Warriors in Anglepoint Wharf in Tiragarde Sound during the Alliance War Campaign.
__NOTOC__ Horde Conspirators are blood elves located at the Temple of the Prophet in Zuldazar during the Alliance War Campaign.
The Hoppy Mead is found throughout the Return to Karazhan. This alcohol was added as part of the Riddle of Jenafur but is not required for it.
Horrific Cores are used to upgrade the rank of Ashjra'kamas, Shroud of Resolve.
Horde Extractors are goblins located in Driftwood Shore in Tiragarde Sound.
Horde Cannon is a cannon located on the pier in Lordamere Lake in Silverpine Forest.
Horrid Eagles are eagles located in the Grizzly Hills in the Emerald Nightmare.
__NOTOC__ Horde Lookouts are orcs and blood elves located in Shimmering Expanse.
Horrific Figments are n'raqi located in the Vision of Stormwind and the Vision of Orgrimmar.
Hoppin' Sad is an exploration achievement earned by shooing the Lost Spawn of Krag'wa towards home in Nazmir.
Hoppers are virmen located in the outside of the Stormstout Brewery. They carry the Habanero Brew that will use on enemies.
Horrific Masquerade is an expansion feature achievement earned by obtaining all 5 Faceless Masks.
The Horned Horse is a projection of a cloudrunner located at the Aspirant's Crucible in Bastion. Orator Kloe will animate it for adventurers to fight, turning it into Aethon.
__NOTOC__ Horrific Bonemaulers are darkhounds located in the woods of Revendreth.
Horde Mortars are cannons found on Horde boats in the Great Sea.
Horde Divers are orcs, goblins, and jungle trolls located in the Great Sea.
Horned Leguaans are saurolisks located at Scavenger's Strand in Zuldazar.
Horrid Experimentation was an Azerite trait available to Unholy death knights.
Horrific Leather Hides are skinned from Horrific Bonemaulers and Bonemauler Alphas in Dredgewood in Revendreth.
Horde Tabard is sold by Provisioner Jin'hake in Exile's Reach for .
Horde Spiritcallers are jungle trolls located in Proudmoore Academy in Boralus.
Horde Wyvernriders are orcs located in Proudmoore Academy in Boralus.
Horker is a lion seal located in Venture Bay in the Grizzly Hills. __NOTOC__

The Horn of the Skeletal Mount was never made available. It would have summoned a Skeletal Horse mount that had black muscles and the same bone and armor colors as the Blue Skeletal Horse, Brown Skeletal Horse, and Red Skeletal Horse.
Hopeless Vessels are souls located in Gorgoa: River of Souls in the Maw.

The Horde Camp is an undisplayed location at the Ogre Ruins on Exile's Reach. After the shipwrecked Horde members clear the area of the undead and defeat Torgok, they establish the Horde Camp by taking over an abandoned camp for use as a temporary base of operations. The ogres at Darkmaul Citadel intended to fire on the camp using catapults, but Herbert Gloomburst lent a recruit some explosives to put the catapults out of commission.
The Horns of Justified Sins are a quest reward from Stones of Binding (Blackrock Depths) (Alliance). This is the same model as the Felheart Raiment.
__NOTOC__ Horde Hostages are orc, tauren, Forsaken, and blood elf prisoners located in Tol Dagor.
Horrible Recollections are manifestations located in Bastion.
Horde Trainees are pandaren located in Eastwind Rest in Kun-Lai Summit. They are the former evacuees and prisoenrs of the region.
Horde Yaks are yaks located in Eastwind Rest and Chow Farmstead in Kun-Lai Summit.
The Horn of Hatuun would have summoned Krokul Ridgestalkers.
Horde Field Defenders are orcs located in the Fields of Blood in the Southern Barrens.
Hornswoggle is a baby parrot pet located near Trainer Iris Greedsway in the Eye of Azshara.
The Horned Hood of Retaliation drops from Inquisitor Meto in Naigtal and Sotanathor in Sangua.
Hornswog Hide Scraps drop from Encroaching Hornswog near Camp Antonidas in the Azure Span.

, A hornswog.]] Hornswogs are a type of frog-like dragonkin found on the Dragon Isles. They are found in water, caves, or areas with volcanic activity. Hornswogs are bullies. They tend to jump around and eat every creatures smaller than them. A swarm of rowdy hornswogs can even bring down and trample a centaur.
Hopefully Healthy is a meat meal created with Dragon Isles Cooking (20); taught by trainers.
Horn of the Wild Hunt is a soulbind trait granted by Korayn. It is exclusive with Wild Hunt's Charge (soulbind trait).
__NOTOC__ Horn o' Mead is sold by Relothina at Nokhudon Hold in the Ohn'ahran Plains.
Horace "Scalding" Stern is a human located at the Obsidian Bulwark in the Waking Shores.

The Horn of Drusahl is a colossal centaur war horn located atop the hill Drusahl in the eastern Ohn'ahran Plains. It is the Maruuk centaur's most sacred relic and a symbol of the ancient pact between the centaur matriarch Teera and the green dragon Merithra. It can only be blown with Ohn'ahra's blessing. The Horn is guarded by a small Teerai village at the base of the hill, now overrun by Clan Nokhud and the Primalists.
Horn Signets are a quest item turned in for Never Forgotten after collecting the following items: *Horn Signet of Rethenash *Horn Signet of Tenezeth *Horn Signet of Katrinasa

Horn Signet of Tenezeth is looted from the body of Tenezeth in the Support Creche in the Forbidden Reach.
Horn Signet of Rethenash is looted from the body of Rethenash in the Support Creche in the Forbidden Reach.

Hornstriders are horned, bipedal, tallstrider-like birds native to the Dragon Isles, mainly in the Waking Shores and Ohn'ahran Plains. They possess bone-breaking beaks, fast legs for getting away from danger, and can eat anything in the Isles. They are omnivorous and mainly eat bugs and roots, but also eat fish and small prey if available. They travel in flocks, grazing on plains or plateaus and moving on when they're out of food. When nesting, they stay in a single location until the chicks are old enough to travel.
Hornspike Swoglets are hornswogs located in Hornspike Nest in the Waking Shores.

__NOTOC__ Hornswog Hollow is, as its name implies, a nesting ground for hornswogs. The Primalists are currently reshaping it with lava, and the local black hornswogs don't seem to mind, care-freely bathing in the steaming magma.
Hornswog Hogwash is a world quest taking place in the Hornswog Hollow of the Waking Shores.

Horn Signet of Arrosh is obtained from Talon Arrosh in the Lost Atheneum in the Forbidden Reach.
Horn Signet of Ekrati is obtained from Talon Ekrati in the Lost Atheneum in the Forbidden Reach.
Horn Signet of Talon Hermin is obtained from Talon Hermin in the Lost Atheneum in the Forbidden Reach.

Horde Infra-green Bombers are bombers sent out from the Horde camp above Aldur'thar: The Desolation Gate in Icecrown. A single bomber is parked here, and Rizzy Ratchwiggle handles requests for bombing runs.
__NOTOC__ Horned Plainstompers are rhinos located in the Ohn'ahran Plains.
Horde Defenders are orcs located in the Northern Barrens. They appear during Counterattack!
__NOTOC__ Horned Filchers are owls located in the Azure Span.
Horn of Scorxia drops from Boneshaper Jardak in the Waking Shores.

Horadric Haversack drops from Treasure Goblins during the A Greedy Emissary event. It has a higher drop rate for the first kill of the day with any subsequent kills or kills on alts having a reduced drop rate.
The Horrible Error is a slime giant located in the central room of Zskera Vault: Ur in the Forbidden Reach.
Horns of Discipline is an appearance unlocked through the use of Ensemble: Hauberk of Discipline.
Horn of the White War Wolf is sold for by Warden Krizzik at Tyrhold Reservoir in Thaldraszus.
Horn of Raging Tempests is sold by Mythressa for and Rethelshi in Valdrakken for .
Hornstrider Scale drops from: *Aggressive Hornstrider *Hornstrider Chick *Hornstrider Runner *Swift Hornstrider
Howl of Terror is a warlock class talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Mortal Coil.

A horse is a large four-legged, four-hoofed animal with a long face, substantial body, and fast, narrow legs. This is the primary mount for humans, which includes, only now to a lesser extent, the worgen of Gilneas. The strong bond between the humans of Azeroth and their warhorses has existed for generations. However, since the fall of Lordaeron, only select varieties continue to be bred throughout Alliance-controlled lands. Most prized among these are the stately Evendales of Elwynn Forest, renowned for their loyalty and even tempers. These horses command a hefty sum, but they reward their owners with steadiness and speed. Horses are widely domesticated for riding and as beasts of burden. K

.]] The Howling Fjord is a region located in southeastern Northrend. Ripped into the southern coastline lies Daggercap Bay. The majestic fortress known as Utgarde Keep is located in the center of this region; it is a dungeon complex and one of its sections is one of the two first instances (the other one being the Nexus) that players encounter when first arriving to Northrend. Howling Fjord contains bases of both factions and does not have a faction-specific emphasis. The only known horusath is Ossirian the Unscarred. He was originally an anubisath who was granted this new form after leading the victory against the bronze dragon Grakkarond.
Hot Wolf Ribs are created by Cooking (175); taught by Recipe: Hot Wolf Ribs.

The Howling Vale is a cave located in north-central Ashenvale, just southwest of the border to Felwood. The vale is a home of the Shrine of Mel'Thandris. In front of the Shrine an ancient inscription, praising Elune, is written. The shrine has an inscription reading "The truth is a guiding light" in Darnassian. The shrine has since become a sacred place to the night elves.
Hot Smoked Bass are created by Classic Cooking (240); taught by Recipe: Hot Smoked Bass. It is also sold by Razgar in Razor Hill during the Heritage of Draenor questline.
The Howling Wind drops from the following air elementals in Nagrand: *Dust Howler *Storm Rager *Living Cyclone
Horse mounts are largely Alliance-only mounts. Horse mounts, in this case, also include those that are embodiments of spirits (Paladin's Chargers, Death Knight's Deathchargers).
Hourglass of the Unraveller drops from Temporus in the Black Morass instance of Caverns of Time.
How to Break into the Arcatraz is the quest which finally grants you a key to the Arcatraz.

A hotfix is a change made to the game deemed critical enough that it cannot be held off until a regular content patch. Hotfixes require only a server-side change with no download and can be implemented with no downtime or with a short restart of the realms. Because there is no download component to a hotfix, there are no downloadable patch notes. Instead, Blizzard announces hotfix information through the forums, the in-game message of the day, and in the Server Alert window on the login screen.
__NOTOC__ Horvon the Armorer is a draenei ghost blacksmithing vendor located at the entrance to the Auchenai Crypts in Terokkar Forest. He can only be seen after completing Vision of the Dead.
Hot Buttered Trout is created with Outland Cooking (50); taught once only by Kylene in Shattrath, now by all trainers. This item is created 2 at a time.
Hot Lion Chops are created by Cooking (125); taught by Recipe: Hot Lion Chops.

While some techno mages are solitary, about twenty years ago several banded together to form a small group of like-minded individuals. Their numbers have grown incrementally since then. Preferring neutrality, this group of techno mages built a small fortress in the Barrens, just south of Ashenvale, making it equal access for all races who wish to learn. They call this fortress, and, by extension, their organization, the House of the Arcane Contraption. Because most techno mages are neutral, or so interested in meeting those of like minds, they welcome any race into their ranks. HousingAuthority is a library used to make easy configurations that go into OptionHouse.
__NOTOC__ Hounds of Culuthas are void hounds located in the Ruins of Farahlon in the Netherstorm.

__NOTOC__ :Steaming hot and flavored with an array of warm spices, a mug of this apple cider will take the chill out of your bones with just a sip. Hot Apple Cider is an alcoholic beverage associated with the Feast of Winter Veil seasonal event.

How to Paladin is a series of machinima movies featuring Shepiwot; a blood elf paladin and is supposedly meant to be teaching viewers how to play this particular class in World of Warcraft, taking approximately five minutes for every piece of cinema. Created by a 23-year-old Dutch player nicknamed “Stoker”, the series has garnered much praise and disapproval for being ‘silly’. The footage is usually played at many times the gaming speed, and background music from the anime One Piece is used as a soundtrack (the most frequently used piece is from a track titled 'Escape' on BGM Music Disc Two). Each video shows Shepiwot jumping, buffing, healing, dancing and killing mobs for no apparent reason
How To Win Friends is the third story in Warcraft: Legends Volume 1. *Written by Dan Jolley *Art by Carlos Olivares *Edited by Troy Lewter

In almost every instance in wow, you'll have at least one noob with you who constantly gets aggro from the mobs. This noob has usually rolled a noobish class like warrior, paladin, druid or - Light help you - death knight, and he probably thinks he's some kind of “tank” or something. Obviously, you must save this noob from the dangerous mobs in the instance. This guide explains how to prevent him from being hit by the mobs, so the party can successfully complete the instance.
This is a list of quests in Howling Fjord. The progression of the storyline in this zone is tracked in the achievement I've Toured the Fjord.
Horrorblood Treads are a world drop from level 67 - 72 Northrend mobs.
Howling Geists are geists located in the Noxious Glade in the Scarlet Enclave during phase 4, the battle for Light's Hope Chapel after completing An End To All Things...
The Howling Hollow is located to the north, and directly below, the Plain of Echoes in the northeastern area of the Storm Peaks. It is filled with storm revenants.

How To Slay Your Dragon is a daily quest for The Sons of Hodir faction, available after hitting with them and having done Forging Hodir's Spear. It involves the new vehicle mechanics introduced in Wrath of the Lich King.

Loot cards are special rare versions of WoW TCG cards found in booster packs, starter decks, and raid decks that have a revealable unique code. Once this protective layer concealing the code is scratched away, a 25 digit promotion code is revealed that can be entered into the Blizzard official promotions page. These codes work for both US and EU servers.

The Horsemen's Assembly is the final room of the Military Quarter in Naxxramas. Here reside the dread Four Horsemen - Thane Korth'azz, Lady Blaumeux, Sir Zeliek and Baron Rivendare, the finest of the death knights of Naxxramas.
The Howling tribe is a small tribe of hostile wolvar found on Cauldros Isle in Howling Fjord.
Hot Pocket (10 player) is a dungeon & raids achievement earned for surviving by being thrown into Ignis the Furnace Master's Slag Pot on 10-player mode.
Howling Wolvar Lookouts are wolvar located on Cauldros Isle in the Howling Fjord.
Howling Wolvar Trainers are wolvar located on Cauldros Isle in the Howling Fjord.
Howling Wolvar Shamans are wolvar located on Cauldros Isle in the Howling Fjord.
Hotter Streak is a player vs. player achievement earned for winning 10 ranked matches in a row with a rating above 1800.
Hourglass of Eternity provides information about a time storm around the Bronze Dragonshrine in the Dragonblight.
Houndmaster's Treads were a quest reward from From the Shadows (quest).
The House of Edune can be found in western Ashenvale, near the Shrine of Aessina and Lake Falathim. The Edune and Dunadaire families live here.

Hot air balloons are balloons attached to baskets and used as transportation through the air. These are mostly used by goblins and pandaren, having two different models by race. The goblin version has attached rockets for controlling where they go, rather than letting the wind.
The Hot Rod is a goblin vehicle driven by the successful goblin players around Kezan.
Houndmaster's Crossbow is a quest reward from From the Shadows (quest).
Horzak Zignibble is a level 16 quest giver located at the Orgrimmar Rocketway Exchange in Azshara. He was present during the Legion Invasions.
Hortak Kenzo is a goblin tailoring supply vendor found at Dragonmaw Port in the Twilight Highlands.
Horrorguards are level 79-81 terrorguards found at the Gates of Sothann in Mount Hyjal.
Hot Spring Sandals is a quest reward from Threat of the Winterfall.

How Hot is a daily quest on the Molten Front unlocked after completing the one-time escort quest Need... Water... Badly..., itself unlocked by acquiring the services of the Druids of the Talon for Mark of the World Tree x150 in Druids of the Talon (quest).

Hounds of Shannox is a daily quest on the Molten Front unlocked after completing the one-time escort quest Need... Water... Badly..., itself unlocked by acquiring the services of the Druids of the Talon for Mark of the World Tree x150 in Druids of the Talon (quest).
Howling Banshees are the servants of Sylvanas Windrunner that have come into the Blackwald in search of the Scythe of Elune. They can be found haunting the eastern half of the forest.
This is a page listing loot to be found in Hour of Twilight. For information about the instance itself, see Hour of Twilight.

Horton Gimbleheart is a gnome quest giver found in Northwatch Hold in the Southern Barrens. He is a colleague of Nibb Spindlegear. It is unknown whether he survived the Razing of Northwatch Hold or not.

Horton Hornblower is a goblin located on a dock at the mouth of the Southfury River. He owns the Riverboat, and gives free transport up the Southfury River to those with Gazlowe's favor during Raging River Ride.
The Hozen Brawler is locked inside a Re-Inforced Jinyu Cage at the Slingtail Pits while players are on the quest Helping the Cause.

The Howlingwind Trail runs from One Keg to the Howlingwind Cavern in central Kun-Lai Summit. From the mouth of the cavern, an unnamed trail continues back to the northwest to reach the Valley of Emperors.

Howlingwind Cavern can be found at the northern end of the Howlingwind Trail coming from One Keg in central Kun-Lai Summit. Just north of the mouth of the cavern is an unnamed trail leading to the southeastern end of the Valley of Emperors.
